themes.label: Free tier limits: ads and skips
themes.summary: Free users say ads are too frequent and too long, sometimes several in a row after a single song, and that skips are capped and free song picks are restricted, so the app feels locked behind Premium. Several reviewers also mention they cannot choose specific songs from playlists or albums and that shuffle repeats the same popular tracks. Many praise the library but say the free experience has degraded compared with earlier versions.
themes.recommendation: Audit ad load and ad length for free users on Android v9.1.72 through v9.1.80 against earlier builds, and pull a report of skip-limit and free song-pick counters to check whether limits are enforced as advertised (for example the 30-minute ad-free window and the hourly skip cap) and whether skipped songs unexpectedly consume free picks.

themes.label: Free tier ad load and restrictions
themes.summary: Free-tier users say ads now play every two to four songs, sometimes with long multi-ad breaks, and that the promised 30 minutes of ad-free listening no longer appears to work. They also describe heavy limits on skips, rewinds, playing albums or playlists in order, and choosing or searching for specific songs, which they see as basic features pushed behind Premium. Many say they are switching to YouTube Music or Apple Music, and a few mention the Android app behaving differently from iOS.
themes.recommendation: Audit the free-tier ad frequency and the 30-minute ad-free window across Android and iOS and versions 9.1.60 to 9.1.80, and compare the results against the intended ad cadence to confirm whether the regression is a bug or a deliberate change; also review the skip, search, and in-order playback limits against the free-tier feature matrix.

themes.label: Playback stops and app crashes
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS report music cutting out between songs, the app crashing or freezing after a few tracks, and playlists or queues failing to load or resetting. Many note the problem started recently or after a specific update, and several say reinstalling or clearing cache did not help. A recurring thread is that premium subscribers feel they are paying for a broken experience and are threatening to cancel.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and playback-interruption logs segmented by app version (especially v9.1.68 through v9.1.80) and OS version, and prioritise a fix for the skip-triggered crash and playback stopping after a few tracks, validated against a regression test on Android and iOS.

themes.label: Music stops and app crashes
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS report playback cutting out mid-song, the app closing or crashing repeatedly, and slow loads, with several saying it began after a specific app update. Downloads disappearing, offline mode failing, and reinstalls not helping also come up, and several reviewers are considering cancelling premium. The reviews span several app versions from 2020 to 2026, so the problem appears to be recurring rather than tied to one release.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and playback-interruption telemetry segmented by app version (starting with v9.1.62 through v9.1.80) and by OS, and check whether background audio session handling or the offline download sync changed in those releases.

themes.label: Boycott over platform ethics concerns
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are mostly boycotting Spotify over ethics rather than a product defect. The most cited grievance is the May 2023 removal of Palestinian songs such as "Dammi Falastini" and Mohamed Assaf's album, which many read as censorship, alongside complaints about ICE-related and defense-linked ads and investments, AI-generated music, low artist royalties, and the 2022 Joe Rogan misinformation controversy. Many say they are cancelling subscriptions or moving to other services.
themes.recommendation: Audit the May 2023 takedown of the Dammi Falastini and Mohamed Assaf tracks to identify which rule or rights flag triggered removal, then publish a transparent restoration and appeal process for affected artists and a clear policy statement on how content is removed.

themes.label: Unwanted songs added to playlists
themes.summary: Users say playing a playlist, album, or liked songs in shuffle mode inserts songs they never added, often similar-genre or algorithmic picks, and they cannot skip or remove them. Several link this to recent updates and to features like smart shuffle and auto-playlists being locked behind Premium, with some reporting the same songs repeating in a fixed order.
themes.recommendation: Audit the shuffle and smart shuffle code path to confirm whether non-playlist tracks are being inserted into playback queues for free and Premium users, and add a test that verifies only user-selected tracks play in shuffle and album playback, prioritizing the Android 9.1.64 and iOS 9.1.68 builds.

themes.label: Subscription price increases and ads
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are upset about repeated Premium price hikes, with several saying the cost is now hard to justify and that they are canceling or looking for alternatives. A second, smaller strand complains about intrusive ads, and a few reviews tie the complaints to political ad content (ICE-related ads) and the company's stance on other issues, which is not a product defect but signals reputational risk.
themes.recommendation: Pull iOS subscription price-change and churn data for the last 12 months, segment cancellations by plan (Individual vs Family) and by reason, and review ad load and ad-content policy on iOS Free and Premium-adjacent screens to see whether ads are appearing for paying subscribers.

themes.label: Free tier limits and ad load
themes.summary: Free users across Android and iOS describe heavy ad frequency, a cap of roughly 6 skips per hour, and limits on choosing specific songs, which together make the app feel unusable without premium. Several reviewers say the limits are new or got worse after recent updates, and some note that the 30 minute ad-free promise does not hold in practice. Some premium-tier users also feel the app pushes upgrades aggressively, even though their own complaints are mostly about bugs.
themes.recommendation: Audit the free-tier skip, song-selection and ad-interval rules introduced in versions 9.1.6x through 9.1.80 against the advertised ad-free window, and publish a clear free-tier limits summary in-app so the promised experience matches what users actually get.

themes.label: Ads interrupting podcast playback
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS report that ad frequency and length have increased sharply in podcasts, including mid-episode breaks, multiple ads in a row, and unskippable ads even for paying Premium subscribers. Several also say the app now auto-plays random or unfamiliar podcasts after an episode ends, and that they are switching to Apple Podcasts, YouTube Music or Amazon Music as a result.
themes.recommendation: Audit ad insertion logic for podcasts by comparing ad load per hour and ad break length for Premium versus free accounts on Android 9.1.80 and 9.1.82, and confirm Premium users never receive ads or unskippable ad breaks inside episodes.

themes.label: Backlash against new app icon
themes.summary: Users across the cluster are strongly objecting to the redesigned iOS app icon, often called a disco ball, calling it ugly, gross, and confusing, and asking for the original green logo to be restored. Some say the new icon is hard to distinguish from scam or phishing lookalikes, and a few want a choice between the old and new icons. The complaints cluster around the May 2026 release (v9.1.46 to v9.1.48), with a few mentions of the CarPlay icon as well.
themes.recommendation: Run a quick survey or A/B test offering users a choice between the original and anniversary icons, and audit the new icon against phishing and lookalike-app risk before the next release.
